_comment: Measured median seconds/page for the CPU classical pipelines, timed load-once on the reference machine (8 vCPU, n=50 forms / n=50 IDs). These are committed constants because the classical per-page run manifests are not part of the run of record; the GPU-served engines (VLMs + Surya) instead recompute their latency from the committed _run*.json manifests. See docs/PROTOCOL.md.
